summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K attaching a letter disclosed as material information to the Chilean Financial Market Commission and local stock exchanges. The letter reports the placement in the local market of senior, dematerialized, bearer bonds, Serie FG, registered under number 11/2022, for a total amount of CLF 880,000 (UF), maturing November 1, 2030, at an average placement rate of 2.81%. This is a routine debt issuance by a foreign private issuer reporting under Rule 13a-16. The filing does not involve a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is simply a routine current report of a regular bond placement, with no special-situation event. No risk-arb angle exists; the event is a standard financing transaction.
